title: Digital Pinball: Necronomicon
native_title: デジタルピンボール 「ネクロノミコン」
overview:
A dark, horror-themed pinball simulation inspired by the Necronomicon. A monk searches for the secret hidden in the forbidden book, and reading it brings on maddening visions; his quest plays out across three tables: Arkham, Cult of the Bloody Tongue and Dreamlands.

The tables are drawn in high resolution and move at 60 frames per second, with on-screen text and voices in English. Spell out words with targets and lanes to light bonuses and special modes, and keep several balls in play during multiball.

- Three tables with their own layouts and rules
- Story mode following the monk's search
- One or two players
